exposure: presence or absence of fetal ascites
outcome: need for urinary drainage catheter at discharge
cohort: 17 patients with isolated persistent cloaca born and treated at a single center between 1991 and 2021
finding: The presence of fetal ascites in patients with persistent cloaca was significantly associated with several differences in perinatal parameters and postnatal management.
mod_finding: The presence of fetal ascites was significantly associated with birth via emergency cesarean delivery.
